cases.prompt: Սիդանս 2.5-ի համար պրոմպտ գրի. տատիկը առավոտյան խոհանոցում գաթա է թխում, 15 վայրկյան, ռիլսի համար
expect: replies in Armenian Unicode, prompt block in English
mode omni, 15 s, 9:16 stated as assumption
time slices continuous and summing to 15 s
explicit sound policy (ambience, music or 'no background music', subtitles)
settings block lists Omni Reference, 15 s, 9:16, 720p

cases.prompt: 30-second one-take, a daughter says goodbye to her father at a bus stop at dawn, realistic, no music
expect: mode timeline-30, not long
three-module structure: reference layer skipped or noted, global settings with specific bans, timestamped storyboard with a why-line per slice
realistic human formula with the pores/skin-texture clause
bans name concrete collapse points (e.g. early tears, extra dialogue, BGM)

cases.prompt: Extend my Seedance video by 10 seconds, the hero should run into the forest. @Video 1 is 12 s.
expect: uses extend mode; checks 12 s < 30 s and result 22 s ≤ 30 s
prompt describes only the new 10 s, states 'after the last frame' (default of the Extend button) or asks before/after once
includes natural-extension continuity clause

cases.prompt: In my uploaded video I drew a red box around the man's jacket. Make it a black leather jacket but only from 4 to 9 seconds.
expect: edit formula: annotation (inside the red box) + target + change + effective time 4-9 s
lists what stays unchanged
notes source ≤ 20 s for stability if length unknown

cases.prompt: Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt where two friends argue in Armenian in a Yerevan cafe, 20 seconds.
expect: flags that Armenian is not on the official language list and recommends a test
offers a fallback (no dialogue + voice in post, or off-screen speaker)
each speaker bound separately; dialogue fits 20 s

cases.prompt: I have 14 character photos and 12 reference videos, make a 30 s party scene with all of them.
expect: flags 12 videos > 10 limit and asks or proposes a reduction
warns 14 subjects is beyond the stable 1-8 (9-12 possible) image range
does not silently drop assets
